Fruit Salad Or Dessert
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:18pm

Ingredients




1 (3 oz.) pkg. cream cheese
1 cup salad dressing
1 cup crushed pineapple, drained
16 lg. marshmallows, quartered
1/2 pt. whipping cream
Sm. bottle maraschino cherries, drained
Strawberry-flavored gelatin

Preparation

1 Whip cream and mix with creamed cheese and dressing. Fold in fruits and marshmallows. Put in pan about 9 x 13 inches. Chill or freeze. 2 When thoroughly firm, pour a layer of strawberry gelatin that has been mixed according to package directions. Be sure gelatin is cool before pouring. Chill until firm. Cut in squares and serve on lettuce for salad or on individual plates for dessert. About 8 servings.
